topics.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid scandal
topics.explanation: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned from his position following reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman suspected of spying for China. The company has appointed CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO while it searches for a permanent successor.
topics.why_it_matters: As a central player in the artificial intelligence industry, Nvidia's sudden leadership vacuum creates significant uncertainty for investors regarding the company's future strategy and its role in the broader AI market.

topics.title: CoreWeave earnings boost investor confidence in AI sector
topics.explanation: AI computing supplier CoreWeave reported stronger-than-expected earnings, which helped soothe investor anxiety regarding the debt loads fueling the AI infrastructure build-out. The positive results contributed to a rebound in tech stocks and provided a lift to the broader Nasdaq.
topics.why_it_matters: CoreWeave's performance serves as a key indicator for the health of the AI ecosystem, showing that demand for AI infrastructure remains strong despite broader market volatility.

topics.title: US home sales hit 16-year low
topics.explanation: Sales of existing US homes fell in October to their lowest level since 2010. High mortgage rates near 7% and rising home prices have deterred potential buyers from entering the market.
topics.why_it_matters: The housing market is a critical component of the economy, and a significant drop in sales volume can signal broader cooling in consumer spending and economic activity.
